meta_description: Download the free Daddy Hunger guide: 5 Promises Every Child Needs From Their Father.
cover_title: 5 Promises Every Child Needs From Their Father
cover_description: A practical guide for helping children feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.
hero_heading: Choose one promise. Practice it faithfully. Then keep becoming.
hero_description: This short guide gives fathers five clear promises, a short explanation of why each promise matters, and one practical action to take today.
checklist: Make sure your child feels seen
Make space for your child to be heard
Love without making your child earn it
preview_heading: Five simple promises with practical next steps.

promises.title: I Will Help You Feel Safe
promises.description: Listen without humiliation, punishment, or abandonment.

promises.title: I Will Make Sure You Feel Seen
promises.description: Notice effort, emotion, interests, questions, and growth.

promises.title: I Will Make Space for You to Be Heard
promises.description: Give attention before trying to solve every problem.

promises.title: I Will Love You Without Making You Earn It
promises.description: Make love the foundation, not the reward.

promises.title: I Will Help Prepare You for Life
promises.description: Model character, teach wisdom, and build confidence.
